# Reference Application: Dobkapapp

This project references the following repository as a functional and
behavioral baseline:

Repository:
- https://github.com/SergeiPatiakin/dobkapapp

Purpose of reference:
- Understand supported workflows and features
- Preserve domain behavior and edge cases
- NOT to replicate technology choices or implementation details

Key aspects to take from the reference:
- Statement import workflow
- Tax calculation concepts
- Filing lifecycle (import → calculate → export → track status)

Explicitly excluded:
- UI technology
- Programming language
- Build tooling
